answer.label: A fabricated Bourdain tweet
answer.sourceLine: Check Your Fact and PolitiFact found no such post in Bourdain’s account or checked archives. The screenshot pretends to show a May 22, 2018 tweet; the contemporaneous posts they checked concern other subjects. The fabricated image’s creator remains unidentified.
